video_title: Yaxel Ready For Go-To Guy Responsibilities?

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are performing better than expected without Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: the Warriors are ahead of where probably we anticipated they would be
quotes.quote: The Warriors, especially after they went down 0-3, are ahead of where probably we anticipated they would be. That is in large part, obviously Stephen Curry has been sensational, but also in large part because they found an instant impact rookie, which is a rookie who is impacting winning, which is pretty rare.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama will be the focus of the Warriors' offense
quotes.excerpt: the spotlight really shifts to Victor Wembanyama
quotes.quote: As Stephen Curry sits and recovers, the spotlight really shifts to Victor Wembanyama. If it's a month, we're going to get a one-month peak at Victor Wembanyama as the go-to guy.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors' high payroll without Stephen Curry is significant
quotes.excerpt: that's 160 million dollars in payroll that they're going to be without

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Between Jimmy Butler, Stephen Curry, Lauri Markkanen, and Kristaps Porzingis, that's 160 million dollars in payroll that they're going to be without. I mean, this has been, it's not the first time this number has been used, it's 160 million dollars in payroll that they're going to be without.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: It's about that. Without Stephen Curry, who obviously is on a max contract, it was 41 percent. So whatever percent Stephen Curry is making, it was 41 percent of their salary.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Well, Stephen Curry is making 35 percent because that's what he's making.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: So yeah, you're talking over 70, blah, blah, blah. So yeah, it's significant.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are prioritizing operational discipline and accountability this season
quotes.excerpt: they just felt they were going to clean up their operation
quotes.quote: Last year, they felt organizationally that they whined too much about the injuries and their age and the schedule and the back-to-backs. They intentionally this offseason went into it saying, we're going to bring back together a majority of a 37-win team, get ridiculed in a lot of ways for doing it, but they just felt they were going to clean up their operation. They were going to take the day-to-day more serious. They hired Frank Vogel to run the defense, he's getting rave reviews. Stephen Curry is reinvigorated, that was part of his three-week contemplation of coming back.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's status for the season remains uncertain
quotes.excerpt: it told all of them that they weren't going to have Victor Wembanyama
quotes.quote: I know they went to Hawaii, but I've also heard that the mini-camp that they had at Jimmy Butler's house, it told all of them that they weren't going to have Victor Wembanyama because Victor Wembanyama was there but very clearly not ready to play.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's personality has won over his teammates
quotes.excerpt: they also came to really like Victor Wembanyama's personality too
quotes.quote: They also came to really like Victor Wembanyama's personality too. That was the big thing, because he's funny. You guys have been around people that are naturally funny. Somebody put it to me like he doesn't have an egotistical bone in his body, partly because of his basketball upbringing. He's just liked, he's constantly saying stuff that has the veterans like, even if it's like, man, you probably shouldn't have said that, they're laughing at it.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors have historically struggled with heavy locker room dynamics
quotes.excerpt: the Warriors have had some heavy locker rooms over the years
quotes.quote: The Warriors have had some heavy locker rooms over the years. Last year was one at this time. Draymond Green punches Jordan Poole, Kevin Durant and Stephen Curry are yelling at each other. The entire last Kevin Durant season. You can tell this team's got a light locker room. It's light.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's early praise from Draymond Green is unusual
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green praising Victor Wembanyama from day one
quotes.quote: Draymond Green praising Victor Wembanyama from day one, Draymond Green is not going to hand out praise to a rookie. That didn't happen every year. You can tell this team's got a light locker room.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's toughness and selflessness define his game
quotes.excerpt: there is a toughness to him under the goofiness
quotes.quote: There is an unselfishness to his game that people like to play with. And also, there is a toughness to him under the goofiness. I mentioned the Summer League, the fact he just played every game, he showed up to work every single day.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's commitment to playing through injury
quotes.excerpt: he went to the finish line
quotes.quote: They get their first win in Denver when they were 0-3. He plays well in it, but he stumbled over his foot and basically he kicked his left foot, he had a huge knot, it was swollen. Between the two games, he had Luka Doncic on Friday, they had a Wednesday game in Minnesota before Luka on Friday, which everybody knew what was coming. I'd heard considering how sore the foot was, they were like, hey, maybe take the Minnesota game off. And he said, no, I want to play, I'm going to play.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans' recent defensive struggles against Warriors and Nets
quotes.excerpt: the Pelicans have lost the last two games by 51 to the Warriors
quotes.quote: The Pelicans have lost the last two games by 51 to the Warriors and then gave up 145 to the Nets. They got Julius Randle and Bobby Portis, they got some scores.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's dunking progress this season
quotes.excerpt: he had the dunk where he took off
quotes.quote: He had the dunk where he took off, he catches it at the three-point line, took two steps and took off and dunked it with two hands. So how many dunks is he up to now? 57 going into Chicago.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's dunking average is consistent
quotes.quote: When we last visited you, it was 57 in 11 games and we were saying he was averaging over five a game. How many do you think he had on Wednesday? He has 62 dunks in 12 games. It's an average night of five.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's impressive finger rolls and skill set
quotes.excerpt: the man has sat on George Gervin's ice throne, he should have some very impressive finger rolls
quotes.quote: The man has sat on George Gervin's ice throne, he should have some very impressive finger rolls. But yeah, when again, one where he catches it at the three-point line, takes two big steps, takes off just a little bit inside the free-throw line and bang a roll. It's just silly watching him. The best comp I can say is Nerf basketball. It looks like he's playing with his little brother's on a Nerf hoop.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's net rating is statistically staggering
quotes.excerpt: his net rating is now plus 30
quotes.quote: His net rating is now plus 30. They're outscoring teams by 30 points per 100 possessions with him on the floor, and when he's off the floor, it's minus 18.4. That's damn near a 50-point swing. It's just mind-boggling.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Victor Wembanyama's impact to Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: I'm curious where that number ends up at the end of the season compared to like the best Nikola Jokic version
quotes.quote: I'm curious where that number ends up at the end of the season compared to like the best Nikola Jokic version of that, right? Because remember that was the story with Nikola Jokic, and still really is in a lot of ways. But he had some insane differentials and I just wonder where Victor Wembanyama ends this year compared to that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Teams are beginning to game plan specifically for Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: now the teams are going to be able to specifically game plan for him
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama is getting seen a little bit in the league and now the teams are going to be able to specifically game plan for him and they will. I'm fascinated to watch him play this role.
